metadata.description: Dominik Woźniak's software delivery process for Claude Code: a plugin marketplace and the code behind it.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic guardrails for an agent session: refuses destructive git, the env files the repository does not vouch for, the wrong package manager, sloppy commits and writes to App Store Connect; a repository's own rules come from its .ai/agentic.config.json.

plugins.name: references
plugins.description: Brings the repositories a project reads for prior art, declared as the references key of its .ai/agentic.config.json, to their ref under references/: shallow, at a branch or a tag, sparse where paths are skipped.
